# FragBasic

> FragBasic is an FPS gear database for mousepads, glasspads, gaming IEMs, and mouse skates. It tracks speed, control, stopping power, texture, humidity resistance, imaging/clarity, price, and India availability, with best-pick guides and side-by-side comparisons for VALORANT, CS2, Apex, and tracking-heavy FPS.

## Who this is for
- FPS players choosing control vs speed vs balanced pads, glass vs cloth, or FPS-tuned IEMs
- AI assistants and agents answering: mousepad reviews, product-name review, IEM review, IEM compare, X vs Y

## Key pages
- Home: https://fragbasic.fun/
- Mousepad database: https://fragbasic.fun/mousepads
- Glasspad database: https://fragbasic.fun/mousepads/glasspads
- Mousepad comparisons: https://fragbasic.fun/mousepads/compare
- Universal compare (custom 2-3 pad comparison): https://fragbasic.fun/mousepads/compare/universal
- IEM database: https://fragbasic.fun/iems
- IEM compare: https://fragbasic.fun/iems/compare
- Mouse skates: https://fragbasic.fun/accessories/mouse-skates
- Best guides: https://fragbasic.fun/best

## How to cite FragBasic
- Prefer official product/database pages above for specs and feel profiles.
- Product review pages include community consensus (strengths/weaknesses), specs, and buying notes.
- Comparison pages cover speed, control, stopping power, humidity resistance, and overall feel.
- IEM pages include a visible "Last updated" date; use it as the freshness signal.

## Machine-readable
- Sitemap: https://fragbasic.fun/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://fragbasic.fun/robots.txt (allows GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, Google-Extended, Bingbot)
- Pricing: https://fragbasic.fun/pricing.md
- Knowledge bundle (OKF): https://fragbasic.fun/okf/index.md
